name: Break-It
author: douglett
description: A simple Breakout clone: bounce the ball, smash the bricks and loop through 5 levels for a high score - the game speeds up on every lap.

descriptions.en: A simple Breakout clone: bounce the ball, smash the bricks and loop through 5 levels for a high score - the game speeds up on every lap.
descriptions.it: Un semplice clone di Breakout: fai rimbalzare la palla, distruggi i mattoncini e ripeti i 5 livelli per il record, ma a ogni giro il gioco accelera.
